p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    def horizontal_mirror(rows):
        return [row[::-1] + row for row in rows]

    return (
        horizontal_mirror(grid[::-1])
        + horizontal_mirror(grid)
        + horizontal_mirror(grid[::-1])
    )
'''
